comparison.objective: Commission an adjustable damper vs lift a heavy laser-cutter lid until gas struts hold it.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tool/collar manipulation and iterative tuning vs symmetric high-force bimanual lifting and controlled support transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Repeated energy absorption within stroke and retention limits vs lid angle, no fall-back or slam, and one-second stable opening.
comparison.reason: The record tests heavy articulated lifting; it does not adjust or validate a damping mechanism.
